description: Terms pre-fetched at startup to populate the RAG store. icd10_terms are resolved against the live, public, keyless NLM Clinical Tables ICD-10-CM API. hcpcs_terms are resolved against the live NLM Clinical Tables HCPCS Level II API. CPT (HCPCS Level I) has no free public lookup API -- AMA holds the copyright -- so cpt_terms are seeded directly from manually curated code/display pairs instead of a live lookup; CPT grounding at runtime is therefore RAG-only with no live fallback.
